AXIOMS: only propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound (verified by #print axioms on all main theorems). No sorry/admit/native_decide.

WHAT IS PROVED (namespace LeanFormal.IUT.XiFPaper.S1844PointSeparatedActual, imports S1843SourceAllPointsActual):
1. S1844SubsingletonMod: 2-cells between strong trans into any representable S1743Y Q are subsingletons ("stack 2-cell uniqueness" for representable targets).
2. S1844YComp / S1844YId: 2-Yoneda functoriality (Y f ; Y g ≅ Y (f≫g), Y 𝟙 ≅ id).
3. S1844SchemePointSeparated A (scheme-point 2-Yoneda form of the atlas) and
   S1844PointSeparated_iff_schemePoints : S1843PointSeparated A ↔ S1844SchemePointSeparated A,
   S1844FirstMissing_iff_schemePoints : S1841FirstMissing ↔ ∀ A, scheme-point injective.
   I.e. the parent's phrase is exactly right: the remaining content is injectivity of S_A -> A.source on scheme points.
4. REFUTATION (the main new result). The doubled affine cover Q = Spec(R'×R') of the identity point gives a square in the actual bicategory of etale stacks over S1726K with
   P = h_Q --Y(proj)--> X = h_{Spec R'}, toY = Y(proj), xToBase = yToBase = identity (S1733BasePoint), i.e. EXACTLY the shape of the identity-point presentation square of the trivial cover (source h_{Spec R'}, map = id) with an "enlarged" pullback scheme:
   - S1844Witness : S1844Square.TwoPullbackWitness — all 7 recorded fields hold (lift = precomposition with the section Spec R' -> Spec(R'×R'); the two 2-cell equations are 2-cell uniqueness).
   - S1844Q_isStack / S1844Base_isStack / S1844Target_isStack: all four objects are actual etale stacks (representable), apex representable, right leg the identity (the S1831 open flag about S1801's constant apex is now closed).
   - S1844RightCancel_fails : ¬ S1843RightCancelOf S1844Square S1844Witness.
   - S1844PointSeparation_fails : injectivity fails on points.
   - S1844EssSurj_fails : ¬ S1827EssSurjOf S1844Square S1844Witness (the EXACT missing half of S1841 also fails).
   - S1844RepresentableSchema_fails : no uniform schema over representable objects.
   Obstruction: the non-identity swap of R'×R' is an automorphism over the base (S1844swap_nabla) with the same projection, but ≠ id (S1844swap_ne, uses Nontrivial R' from S1726PointAlgHom); recorded lift evaluates to ∇;ι = (a,b)↦(a,a) ≠ swap (S1844Lift_eval, S1844nabla_iota_ne_swap).

VERDICT: PointSeparated/RightCancel is NOT derivable from IsStack + atlas + all-point finite-etale base-change presentations + 2-Yoneda + 2-cell uniqueness. The missing input is genuinely the FULL 2-dimensional universal property of the identity-point presentation square (equivalently its "pullback scheme" is the actual fiber). Definition EtaleStackBaseChangePresentation (weak witness) admits enlarged, non-genuine presentations. So closing S1841FirstMissing needs either strengthening TwoPullbackWitness/the presentation definition to the full 2-universal property, or the geometric theorem that the recorded presentation IS a full 2-pullback (which is the target).

CAVEATS (also in the file header, honest):
- No cover (OrbicurveFiniteEtaleCover) is constructed; the tree has no construction of EtaleStackFiniteEtaleMorphism at all. So "∀ A, S1843PointSeparated A" is NOT literally refuted; what is refuted is the uniform schema for squares with actual stack objects, representable apex, identity right leg, in the exact presentation shape.
- Finite-etaleness of the projections is not used and not formalised (the recorded witness does not contain it either).
- Probes left: S1844Probe1/2/3b.lean (scratch, compile); broken scratch probes S1844Probe3/3c/5 removed.

Not done here: coord/STATE.md, coord/queue.md, AUDIT_LEDGER.md updates (left to you to avoid concurrent-edit conflicts).
